description: Use AFTER match_offer identifies GlobalStat, or when the user explicitly asks for sourced country/domain evidence. Queries the live read-only GlobalStat evidence layer for up to 8 ISO3 countries, preserving observation year, evidence state, confidence, source URLs, reconciliation warnings and methodology context. It does not manufacture an overall winner, recommendation, payment or external action.

countries.description: ISO3 country codes, for example USA, CAN, JPN.

name: query_globalstat_country_intelligence
title: Query sourced country intelligence with GlobalStat
